SCENE sc_001 0-34200 EXT. CATHEDRAL STEPS – DAY
EP40:E1 0-4800 CAMERA: Wide establishing shot looking up at the imposing stone Gothic cathedral as noble guests in formal Regency attire ascend the grand steps.
EP40:E2 0-4800 SOUND: Somber cathedral bells tolling and the distant murmur of arriving carriages.
EP40:E3 4800-8500 CAMERA: Medium wide shot of an ornate black and gold royal carriage pulling up to the cobblestone courtyard. A footman in white gloves steps forward and opens the carriage door.
EP40:E4 5500-7400 FOOTMAN [Formal, Resonant]: "The Harrington family."
EP40:E5 8500-12200 CAMERA: Medium shot as Lord Harrington in a tailored black tailcoat and white waistcoat steps down from the carriage, turning to extend his gloved hand to Lady Harrington, who gracefully descends.
EP40:E6 10000-12400 ACTION: Lady Harrington takes his hand and steps onto the pavement, clutching a velvet reticule.
EP40:E7 12400-17300 LADY HARRINGTON [Smug, Impressed]: "Look at them. Every noble family in the county is here today."
EP40:E8 12400-19000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot tracking slightly as Lord and Lady Harrington pause arm-in-arm, taking in the gathering crowd of high society.
EP40:E9 19000-23000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot from behind as they ascend the stone steps toward the arched cathedral entrance.
EP40:E10 19200-23000 LORD HARRINGTON [Ambitious, Proud]: "And soon, we'll be connected to the Duchess of Ashburgh."
EP40:E11 23000-26200 CAMERA: Tight close-up profile of Lady Harrington, her eyes glistening with cruel satisfaction in the soft sunlight.
EP40:E12 23200-26000 LADY HARRINGTON [Malicious, Taunting]: "Imagine Juliana seeing this."
EP40:E13 26200-30000 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Lord Harrington looking down at her, his expression cold and ruthless.
EP40:E14 26200-28900 LORD HARRINGTON [Sinister, Dismissive]: "She won't be seeing anything for long."
EP40:E15 29000-29900 LADY HARRINGTON [Pleased, Cold]: "Good."
EP40:E16 30100-33200 LORD HARRINGTON [Chuckling, Scornful]: "This place has always been unlucky for Juliana."
EP40:E17 32800-34200 ACTION: Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.
SCENE sc_002 34200-49800 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP40:E18 34200-40500 CAMERA: Dramatic tracking shot following Lord and Lady Harrington from behind as they stride down the candlelit aisle of the cathedral toward their reserved pew.
EP40:E19 34400-39000 LADY HARRINGTON [Vindictive, Pious]: "She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves."
EP40:E20 40500-42200 ACTION: Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.
EP40:E21 40500-45200 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of the couple seated in the pew, looking toward the grand altar.
EP40:E22 42000-44000 LADY HARRINGTON [Anticipatory, Eager]: "We have an excellent view."
EP40:E23 44100-45200 LORD HARRINGTON [Inquiring, Subdued]: "Of the wedding?"
EP40:E24 45200-49800 CAMERA: Close-up two-shot as Lady Harrington turns her head toward Lord Harrington with a dark, knowing smirk.
EP40:E25 45300-48300 LADY HARRINGTON [Chilling, Sarcastic]: "And everything that comes after it."
SCENE sc_003 49800-78500 INT. CATHEDRAL – ALTAR & BALCONY – CONTINUOUS
EP40:E26 49800-55800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert, the Blond Nobleman, standing before the altar draped in floral garlands. He wears an ornate silver-embroidered black formal coat and nervously adjusts his pristine white gloves.
EP40:E27 50800-53200 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Nervous, Determined]: "Everything must go perfectly."
EP40:E28 53200-55800 ACTION: Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.
EP40:E29 55800-58200 CAMERA: Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.
EP40:E30 58200-63800 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.
EP40:E31 63800-69500 CAMERA: Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.
EP40:E32 65000-66800 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Stern, Scheming]: "All entrances are covered?"
EP40:E33 66900-68200 ROYAL GUARD [Obedient, Firm]: "Every one, my Lord."
EP40:E34 68300-69300 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Calculating]: "Good."
EP40:E35 69500-74500 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.
EP40:E36 69800-74200 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Ruthless, Victorious]: "By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess."
EP40:E37 74500-78500 CAMERA: Tight, menacing close-up on the elder nobleman's face as a cold, sinister smile spreads across his lips.
EP40:E38 74800-77400 ELDER NOBLEMAN [Deadly, Uncompromising]: "And its witch will be dead."
SCENE sc_004 78500-110080 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP40:E39 78500-81000 SOUND: The heavy creak of massive wooden cathedral doors swinging open, accompanied by swelling bridal organ music.
EP40:E40 78500-81000 CAMERA: Wide symmetrical shot down the candlelit aisle as the double doors part, flooding the cathedral with brilliant golden daylight.
EP40:E41 81000-82500 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert turning his head sharply, his eyes widening in awe.
EP40:E42 82500-85800 CAMERA: Framed wide shot of Catherine silhouetted in the bright doorway, wearing a breathtaking cream and gold imperial bridal gown with puffed sleeves and an exquisite sheer veil.
EP40:E43 85800-90800 CAMERA: Majestic high-angle wide tracking shot following Catherine from behind as her magnificent cathedral-length veil trails down the aisle between seated guests.
EP40:E44 90800-94500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Harrington leaning forward from her pew, utterly captivated.
EP40:E45 92000-94200 LADY HARRINGTON [Awestruck, Whispering]: "She looks like a queen."
EP40:E46 94500-97500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert at the altar, a proud, possessive smile breaking across his handsome face.
EP40:E47 97500-102800 CAMERA: Full shot as Catherine reaches the top of the altar steps. Rupert steps forward and takes her gloved hands into his.
EP40:E48 100000-102800 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Enamored, Flattering]: "You look more queen than bride."
EP40:E49 102800-110080 CAMERA: Tight two-shot profile of Catherine and Rupert clasping hands intimately, gazing into each other's eyes with shared aristocratic vanity.
EP40:E50 105000-109000 CATHERINE [Smug, Coquettish]: "And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin."
EP40:E51 109000-110080 ACTION: Rupert and Catherine exchange conspiratorial, triumphant smiles at the altar as the solemn organ chord holds and the scene cuts to black.
